text: You'll love this Avocado, Tomato & Corn Salad/Salsa recipe! It's a perfect fit for your taste preferences, featuring fresh tomatoes and creamy avocado. The addition of corn and a hint of spice from the jalapeno or chipotle chile will add a delightful twist. Since it's quick to prepare, you can easily fit it into your 15-minute time frame. Plus, it's nut-free, so you don't have to worry about any dietary restrictions. Give it a try and enjoy a fresh, flavorful dish that's sure to satisfy your cravings!
